subject: Dedicated slot scheduling for AtlasML pilot — weekly alignment
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Dedicated slot scheduling for AtlasML pilot — weekly alignment

Team —

Quick sync for this week's runway planning with AtlasML (see attached capacity request). They're asking for a reserved tranche to support a time-boxed pilot and we need to lock the operational plan + finance signoff this week if we want capacity allocated in early Dec.

Snapshot (from AtlasML forecast):
- Pilot duration: 6 weeks (dev + validation + pilot run)
- Peak concurrency: 6 vGPU sessions (seq length typically 1k tokens)
- Recommended reserved footprint: 4 dedicated slots with burst to 8 for spikes
- Expected tokens/day: ~12M during peak week

Asks:
1) Infra (Jordan) — confirm if we can provision 4 dedicated slots (A100-equivalent) starting week of Dec 3, with burst pool available. If we need a lead time, state exact provisioning deadline.
2) Sales (Laura) — confirm commercial approach: 4x reserved vs 8x burst credits; which option do we push to the customer draft PO?
3) FinOps (Ben) — quick cost + discount recommendation for a 6-week pilot (we want to present a clean number to procurement).

Attachments: AtlasML_capacity_request.csv (requested slot schedule) and Atlas_PO_Draft.pdf (procurement draft).

Proposed next steps: 1) Jordan confirms infra availability by EOD today; 2) Ben sends a one-page cost estimate by 11/6 15:00 UTC; 3) Laura confirms commercial path and whether legal should get a preliminary SOW.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated slot scheduling for AtlasML pilot — weekly alignment

Thanks Sergio — good summary. A couple quick items from commercial: 

- I prefer the customer-facing ask to be a 4-slot reserved with an explicit burst profile up to 8 for short windows. It keeps their committed spend lower while giving them runway for validation spikes.
- For procurement: we'll propose a 6-week pilot at a reduced pilot rate (~40% off list) and then a conversion path to monthly reserved pricing if they convert within 90 days.

Questions for team:
- Ben: can you surface two price lines in the one-pager (pilot rate and conversion rate)?
- Jordan: if infra can only commit to 2 slots immediately, note it — we'll push a hybrid (2 reserved + 6 burst).

If the infra lead time is > 2 weeks we'll need to push start to Dec 17 instead of Dec 3. I'll prep a short SOW template if legal will need it.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated slot scheduling for AtlasML pilot — weekly alignment

Laura / Sergio —

Attached is a quick cost model (ATL_cost_model_Q1_2030.xlsx) with three options:

A) Pilot reserved: 4 reserved slots, pilot-rate discount applied (40% off list) — estimated total for 6 weeks: $82,400
B) Hybrid: 2 reserved + burst to 8 (burst priced at on-demand uplift) — estimated total: $69,200
C) On-demand only (no reserve) — estimated total: $110,000 (higher variable risk)

Notes:
- The numbers assume A100-equivalent pricing and typical token mix from the Atlas forecast.
- If they sign an intent to convert to monthly reserved within 90 days, we can apply a conversion credit of up to 30% of pilot spend. That needs legal approval on SOW.
- Please confirm which option you want in the PO; I can turn the spreadsheet into the one-page IO for procurement.

Jordan — from infra side, if you confirm provisioning by EOD today I can tag the option A numbers in the IO. If infra can only do 2 reserved immediately we should pick B and present a clear burst policy.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
FinOps Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachment: ATL_cost_model_Q1_2030.xlsx)

From: Jane Morris <jane@atlasml.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasml.com
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2029 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated slot scheduling for AtlasML pilot — weekly alignment

Thanks for the clear breakdown. AtlasML is aligned with the 4-reserved + burst-to-8 approach as long as we receive: 

- A 6-week firm pilot SOW with pilot pricing noted (we prefer the pilot discount line)
- A DocuSign link for a short PO or an explicit PDF we can sign and route to procurement
- A clear escalation contact if we hit throughput issues during the pilot (we'll need SLOs / pager ops contact)

Timeline: procurement is ready to sign this week if we get the IO + SOW by 11/8. Target pilot start remains Dec 3, but we can shift to Dec 17 if Redwood needs extra lead time.

Jane Morris
Head of ML Engineering
AtlasML
